name: Boltzmann distribution
statement: Probability of a microstate in canonical ensemble.

name: RSA encryption
statement: Encryption: c = m^e mod n, Decryption: m = c^d mod n.
latex: c = m^e \pmod n,\ m = c^d \pmod n
unicode: c = m^e mod n, m = c^d mod n

name: Compactness theorem
statement: A set of sentences has a model iff every finite subset has a model.
latex: \text{If } \Sigma \text{ is finitely satisfiable, then } \Sigma \text{ is satisfiable}
unicode: If Σ is finitely satisfiable, then Σ is satisfiable

name: Snake lemma
statement: Long exact sequence from commutative diagram with exact rows.

name: Van Kampen theorem
statement: Fundamental group of union via free product with amalgamation.

name: Wedderburn's little theorem
latex: R \text{ finite division ring } \Rightarrow R \text{ field}
unicode: R finite division ring ⇒ R field

name: Gauss-Bonnet-Chern theorem
statement: Total curvature relates to Euler characteristic.

name: Dirichlet's theorem on arithmetic progressions
statement: Infinitely many primes in arithmetic progression.
unicode: primes ≡ a (mod d) infinite if gcd(a,d)=1

name: Martingale convergence theorem
unicode: Mₙ → M_∞ a.s. if supₙ E[|Mₙ|] < ∞

name: Modus ponens
statement: From P and P→Q, infer Q.

name: De Morgan's law (conjunction)
statement: Negation of conjunction equals disjunction of negations.

name: Central limit theorem
statement: Standardized sample mean converges to standard normal.
